title: Join the $6 Million Dollar Supernova Hackathon
section: 42. Minting NFTs and Building an NFT Marketplace like OpenSea
summary: Promotional article closing the Internet Computer section: it points learners to a 2022 global hackathon run by the Internet Computer ecosystem. No code or exercise.

concepts.heading: Key takeaways
points: Announcement for a global Internet Computer hackathon (10 May to 20 June 2022) with more than $6 million in prizes and grants, aimed at learners who now know Motoko and ICP development.
Contains a registration link and asks participants to share their projects with the instructor on Twitter.
(Extra) The event dates are long past, so treat this as an admin or marketing item; the useful idea is that DFINITY grants and hackathons exist for ICP projects.
(Extra) Content taken from the reference repo's README for this lesson, because the lecture page in the browser tab showed only an Open button rather than the article body.
